'''Lucia Votano''' (born 2 November 1947) is an Italian [[Astroparticle physics|astroparticle physicist]], and the first woman to direct the [[Laboratori Nazionali del Gran Sasso|Gran Sasso National Laboratory]],<ref name="interactions_pressrelease" /> from 2009 to 2012.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.unimib.it/node/9914 |title=Laboratori del Gran Sasso, il nuovo direttore è un prof. dell'Università di Milano-Bicocca |date=28 September 2012 |language=it}}</ref> Her research focuses on [[neutrino]]s, and she was the coordinator of the [[OPERA experiment]], that led to the first detection of [[tau neutrino]]s from [[muon neutrino]] [[neutrino oscillation|oscillation]].

== Early life and education ==
Votano studied humanities at the [[Liceo Classico]] Tommaso Campanella in Reggio Calabria; later she obtained her degree in General Physics from the [[Sapienza University of Rome]] in 1971, graduating ''cum laude''. Her interest in science was fuelled in her young years by her father, a radiologist, who was passionate about scientific research and first narrated the discovery of DNA to her.<ref name ="assolombarda">{{cite web |url=https://www.assolombarda.it/steamiamoci/le-protagoniste-del-futuro/lucia-votano-fisico-e-scienziata-dirigente-di-ricerca-dellistituto-nazionale-di-fisica-nucleare-prima-donna-a-dirigere-il-laboratorio-nazionale-del-gran-sasso |title=Lucia Votano, fisico e scienziata. Dirigente di ricerca dell'INFN. Prima donna a dirigere il Laboratorio Nazionale del Gran Sasso |language=it |publisher=Assolombarda}}</ref>

== Life and career ==
=== Academic career ===

She started her career as a researcher of the [[INFN|National Institute for Nuclear Physics]] at the [[Frascati National Laboratory]] in 1976. She collaborated with research projects at [[CERN]], in particular the [[Intersecting Storage Rings|ISR]] and the [[WA44 experiment|WA44]] experiment. Between 1985 and 1998 she participated at the [[ZEUS]] experiment at the [[DESY]] research center in [[Hamburg]].<ref name="interactions_pressrelease" /> 

In 1988, Votano became Senior Researcher and in 2000 she was promoted to Research Director.<ref name="interactions_pressrelease" /> She covered the role of coordinator of the [[OPERA experiment]], whose data collection started in 2006 and resulted in the detection of 5 [[tau neutrino]]s from [[muon neutrino]] [[neutrino oscillation|oscillations]]. In 2009, the board of directors of the INFN appointed her as Director of the [[Laboratori Nazionali del Gran Sasso|Gran Sasso National Laboratory]]; she was the first woman to cover this role, which she held until 2012, when she was succeeded by [[Stefano Ragazzi]].<ref name="Quotidianonet_20210928">{{cite news |url=https://www.quotidiano.net/cronaca/2012/09/28/778962-milano-ragazzi-cern-gran-sasso.shtml |title=Cern di Ginevra, nominato il nuovo direttore dei Laboratori del Gran Sasso |publisher=Quotidiano.net |date=28 September 2012 |accessdate=2022-02-03 |language=it}}</ref>

Her reaction to the media coverage following the appointment to the prestigious role was two-fold: on one side she deemed it positive, as it highlighted the fact that "finally a woman had conquered a position at the top of the scientific leadership"; on the other hand it was negative, "because if that was the norm, [the news of the appointment] would not have caused any clamour".<ref name ="assolombarda" /><ref>{{cite journal | last=Kaplan | first=Karen | title=Lucia Votano | journal=Nature | publisher=Springer Science and Business Media LLC | volume=460 | issue=7258 | year=2009 | issn=0028-0836 | doi=10.1038/nj7258-1047a | page=1047| doi-access=free }}</ref> In 2011 at an international symposium held in Vatican City, he gave a talk ''Achievements in Subnuclear Physics at Fermilab''.<ref>{{cite book|editor=Sánchez Sorondo, Marcelo|editor-link=Marcelo Sánchez Sorondo|editor2=Zichichi, Antonino|editor-link2=Antonino Zichichi|chapter=''Achievements in Subnuclear Physics at Fermilab'' by Pier Oddone|pages=82–96|title=Subnuclear Physics: Past, Present and Future; Proceedings of the International Symposium, held 30 October – 2 November 2011, held in Vatican City|series=Scripta Varia, volume 119|publisher=[[Pontifical Academy of Sciences]]|year=2014|chapter-url=https://www.pas.va/content/dam/casinapioiv/pas/pdf-volumi/scripta-varia/sv119/sv119-oddone.pdf}}</ref> In 2011 she gave a talk ''Origin and Status of the Gran Sasso Laboratory'' at the international symposium on subnuclear physics held in Vatican City.<ref>{{cite book|editor=Sánchez Sorondo, Marcelo|editor-link=Marcelo Sánchez Sorondo|editor2=Zichichi, Antonino|editor-link2=Antonino Zichichi|chapter=''Origin and Status of the Gran Sasso Laboratory'' by Lucia Votano|pages=328–336|title=Subnuclear Physics: Past, Present and Future; Proceedings of the International Symposium, held 30 October – 2 November 2011, held in Vatican City|series=Scripta Varia, volume 119|publisher=[[Pontifical Academy of Sciences]]|year=2014|chapter-url=https://www.pas.va/content/dam/casinapioiv/pas/pdf-volumi/scripta-varia/sv119/sv119-votano.pdf}}</ref>

As of 2020, she is part of the 600 scientists currently working on [[JUNO]], a neutrino experiment under construction in Southern China.<ref>{{cite news|url =https://nuvola.corriere.it/2020/03/29/io-ricercatrice-tra-litalia-e-la-cina/ |title= Io, ricercatrice tra l'Italia e la Cina |author=Laura Aldorisio |publisher=Corriere della Sera |date=29 March 2020 |accessdate = 2 March 2021 |language=it}}</ref>

=== Publications ===
Votano authored or co-authored about 300 scientific publications in [[peer review|peer-reviewed]] journals. She is also the author of two books:<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.raicultura.it/filosofia/articoli/2019/03/Lucia-Votano-Rivelazioni-9bd9e9fc-61d7-4f5d-bb5d-2d05db034692.html |title= Lucia Votano. Rivelazioni |publisher = Rai Cultura |language=it}}</ref>
* ''Il fantasma dell'universo'', Carocci Editore, 2015, {{ISBN|9788843075188}}
* ''La via della seta. La fisica da Enrico Fermi alla Cina.'' Di Renzo Editore, 2017, {{ISBN|9788883233173}}

=== Honours and awards ===
* In 2009, she received the Minerva prize for scientific research.<ref name="infn_minerva">{{cite web |url=http://www.infn.it/news/news.php?id=550 |title=Lucia Votano vince il Premio Minerva 2009 |publisher=[[INFN]] |date=11 December 2009 |language=it}}</ref>
* In March 2010, she was awarded the [[Order of Merit of the Italian Republic]] by the Italian president, [[Giorgio Napolitano]].<ref name="Quotidianonet_20210928" />
* In 2019, she became honorary member of the [[Italian Physical Society]].<ref>{{cite magazine|url = https://www.ilnuovosaggiatore.sif.it/download/60 |title=Cerimonia inaugurale 105° Congresso Nazionale della Società Italiana di Fisica |magazine= Il nuovo Saggiatore |page = 57 | volume=35 |issue=5–6 |language=italian}}</ref>
